title.en: Mission Accomplished: LyctRides Delivers Ground Transport for the 139th Canton Fair
title.cn: 圆满交付：光年完美保障第 139 届广交会海外采购商出行

summary.en: From mid-April through early May, our Guangzhou team handled airport-to-fair logistics for international buyers and exhibitors at the world's largest trade fair — every pickup on time, every chauffeur briefed, every itinerary held.
summary.cn: 4 月中至 5 月初，光年广州团队为第 139 届广交会海外采购商与参展商提供机场至会场的全程地面出行 — 每一程准时、每一位司机训练有素、每一段行程稳如磐石。

en: On May 5, the 139th China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair) officially concluded at the Guangzhou Pazhou Complex after three back-to-back phases over three weeks. Across the entire run, LyctRides served as a primary ground transportation partner for select multinational delegations, Fortune-Global-500 buying offices, and several pavilion organisers — and we are proud to report not a single missed pickup.

The operation involved over thirty bilingual chauffeurs running shuttle and door-to-door routes between Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport (CAN), Hong Kong International (HKG), and the Pazhou Complex, alongside ad-hoc evening services to receptions, business dinners, and offsite meetings. Our on-site dispatch desks at four major Pazhou-area hotels operated 18 hours a day across each phase.

For our international clients, the value was direct and tangible: real-time flight tracking absorbed the inevitable schedule shifts; name-board greeters at arrivals removed any local-language coordination burden; and a single concierge contact handled every last-minute change without escalation. We logged over 1,800 individual journeys across the three phases.

Our thanks go to every chauffeur, dispatcher, and account manager who held the standard. As one client wrote in a brief mid-fair note: "You ran our entire week here. We didn't think about transport once." That is the entire point.

Preparations for the 140th Canton Fair (October–November 2026) are already underway. Returning clients, please reach out via your dedicated account manager. New enquiries can reach our Guangzhou desk directly through the WhatsApp, WeChat, or email channels on this site.
cn: 5 月 5 日，第 139 届中国进出口商品交易会（广交会）在广州琶洲展馆完成连续三期、为期近三周的全部展期。整个会期内，光年作为多家跨国代表团、世界 500 强采购办公室及多家展馆组织方的主要地面出行合作伙伴 — 全程零遗漏、零失误。
本次保障调度逾三十位双语司机，往返于广州白云国际机场（CAN）、香港国际机场（HKG）与琶洲展馆之间，承担班车与门到门接送，并随时承接晚宴、客户接待、场外会议等弹性需求。光年在琶洲核心区四家主接待酒店设立的现场调度台，每期保持每日 18 小时持续运转。
对国际客户而言，价值是直接可感的：航班实时追踪自动同步行程变更，到达大厅举牌接车免去本地语言沟通障碍，单一礼宾对接人处理所有临时调整无需层层升级。三期展会累计完成逾 1,800 次单程接送任务。
感谢每一位坚守标准的司机、调度员与客户经理。一位客户在会期中段简短留言：「你们撑起了我们整周的行程，我们一次都没有为交通操过心。」 这正是我们工作的全部意义。
第 140 届广交会（2026 年 10–11 月）的筹备工作已启动。老客户请通过您的专属客户经理联系我们；新客户可通过本页底部的 WhatsApp、微信或邮件直接对接广州接待台。

title.en: LyctRides Expands to 10 New Cities Across the Greater Bay Area
title.cn: 光年拓展至大湾区10座新城市

summary.en: Our network now spans over 300 cities across Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan, bringing world-class ground transportation to more corporate travellers than ever before.
summary.cn: 我们的服务网络现已覆盖中国大陆、香港、澳门及台湾逾300座城市，为更多企业客户提供世界级地面出行服务。

en: LyctRides today announced the expansion of its premium ground transportation network to 10 additional cities across the Greater Bay Area, bringing its total coverage to over 300 cities across Greater China.
The expansion reflects growing demand from multinational corporations operating across the GBA corridor, where seamless inter-city executive mobility has become a critical business requirement.

New coverage includes Zhongshan, Jiangmen, Zhuhai, Huizhou, and six additional tier-2 cities within the Pearl River Delta region, complementing existing services in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Hong Kong, and Macau.

Corporate accounts can now book multi-leg journeys across the full GBA corridor through a single point of contact, with consistent EHL-certified service standards at every destination. All vehicles are GPS-tracked, all chauffeurs are certified, and all bookings are backed by 24/7 concierge support.
Bookings for the new cities are available immediately through the existing inquiry channels.
cn: 光年今日宣布，将其高端地面出行网络扩展至大湾区10座新城市，总覆盖城市数量突破300座。
此次扩张是对跨湾区运营的跨国企业日益增长需求的回应——无缝的城际高管出行已成为重要的商务需求。
新增覆盖城市包括中山、江门、珠海、惠州，以及珠三角腹地六座新兴城市，与现有的广州、深圳、香港、澳门服务形成完整网络。
企业客户现可通过单一联系人完成跨大湾区全程预订，每个目的地均提供EHL认证的统一服务标准。所有车辆均配备GPS追踪，所有司机均持证上岗，所有预订均有24/7礼宾支持。
新增城市服务即日起可通过现有咨询渠道预订。

title.en: LyctRides Named Best Luxury Chauffeur Service — China Business Travel Awards 2024
title.cn: 光年荣获2024中国商务出行最佳豪华专车服务奖

summary.en: Recognised for operational excellence and client satisfaction across our Greater China network, this award reflects the dedication of every team member.
summary.cn: 凭借卓越的运营水准与客户满意度，光年荣获该奖项，这是每位团队成员共同努力的结果。

en: LyctRides has been named Best Luxury Chauffeur Service at the China Business Travel Awards 2024, one of the most prestigious recognitions in the corporate mobility industry.

The award was presented at the annual gala in Shanghai, where LyctRides was recognised for its consistent service standards, client retention rates, and innovation in fleet management across Greater China.
Our EHL-certified training programme — requiring over 200 hours of coursework from every chauffeur — was specifically highlighted by the judging panel as a differentiating factor in service quality.

This is the second consecutive year LyctRides has received recognition from the China Business Travel Awards, reflecting our ongoing commitment to raising the standard of executive ground transportation.
We are deeply grateful to our clients whose trust and feedback drive us to improve every single day.
cn: 光年荣获2024年中国商务出行大奖「最佳豪华专车服务」称号，这是企业出行行业最具声望的奖项之一。
颁奖典礼在上海举行，光年凭借在大中华区始终如一的服务标准、高客户留存率及车队管理创新获此殊荣。
评委会特别指出，光年的EHL认证培训体系——要求每位司机完成逾200小时课程——是服务质量的核心竞争力所在。
这是光年连续第二年获得中国商务出行大奖的认可，彰显我们持续提升高管地面出行服务标准的承诺。
我们衷心感谢每一位客户的信任与反馈，正是这些激励我们每天不断精进。

title.en: New Multi-Year Agreement with Leading Fortune 500 Enterprise
title.cn: 光年与世界500强企业签署多年战略合作协议

summary.en: A landmark multi-year agreement to provide executive ground transportation across 15 cities, covering over 2,000 annual journeys for C-suite and senior leadership.
summary.cn: 里程碑式合作协议，为其高管提供覆盖15个城市、逾2,000次年度行程的专属礼宾出行服务。

en: LyctRides has entered into a multi-year strategic partnership with a leading Fortune 500 enterprise operating across Greater China, providing dedicated executive ground transportation services.

The agreement covers C-suite and senior leadership travel across 15 cities, representing over 2,000 annual journeys. A dedicated account team has been assigned to ensure seamless coordination across all locations.
Under the agreement, LyctRides will provide 24/7 priority concierge support, guaranteed vehicle availability within 60 minutes, and quarterly service reviews with senior leadership on both sides.
This partnership exemplifies the trust that leading global enterprises place in LyctRides as their ground transportation partner of choice in Greater China.
Details of the client remain confidential in accordance with our discretion policy.
cn: 光年与一家在大中华区运营的世界500强企业签署多年战略合作协议，为其提供专属高管地面出行服务。
协议涵盖该企业高管团队在15座城市的出行保障，年出行次数超过2,000次。光年已为此配置专属客户服务团队，确保各城市间的无缝协调。
根据协议，光年将提供24/7优先礼宾服务、60分钟内保障用车，并每季度与双方高层进行服务复盘。
这一合作彰显了全球领先企业对光年作为大中华区首选地面出行合作伙伴的高度信任。
依据我们的保密原则，客户具体信息不予披露。

title.en: Introducing the ZEEKR 009 — Zero-Emission Luxury for the Modern Executive
title.cn: 全新加入：极氪009 — 面向现代高管的零排放豪华出行

summary.en: Our newest fleet addition brings sustainable luxury travel to corporate clients who demand the highest standards without compromise — including a 702 km range and ultra-quiet cabin.
summary.cn: 光年最新加入的车型，为追求卓越的企业客户带来可持续豪华出行体验，续航702公里，超静音座舱。

en: LyctRides is pleased to announce the addition of the ZEEKR 009 to our premium fleet, marking a significant step in our commitment to sustainable executive mobility.

The ZEEKR 009 is China's leading premium electric MPV, combining a 702 km CLTC range with an ultra-quiet NVH-engineered cabin, panoramic roof, and intelligent climate control — delivering first-class comfort with zero tailpipe emissions.

For corporate clients with sustainability mandates or ESG reporting requirements, the ZEEKR 009 offers a seamless way to reduce their business travel carbon footprint without any compromise on comfort or service level.
All ZEEKR 009 vehicles in our fleet are maintained to the same EHL-certified standards as our Mercedes-Benz models, with the same 24/7 concierge support and guaranteed service quality.
The ZEEKR 009 is now available for booking across our Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Shanghai network.
cn: 光年正式宣布将极氪009纳入旗下豪华车队，标志着我们在可持续高管出行领域迈出重要一步。
极氪009是中国领先的高端纯电MPV，CLTC续航702公里，配备精工调音超静音座舱、全景天窗及智能气候系统，在零排放的同时提供头等舱级别的乘坐体验。
对有可持续发展目标或ESG报告需求的企业客户而言，极氪009是降低商务出行碳足迹的理想选择，且丝毫不牺牲舒适度与服务品质。
车队中所有极氪009均按照与奔驰车型相同的EHL认证标准维护保养，配备同等级别的24/7礼宾服务与服务质量保障。
极氪009现已在广州、深圳、上海网络范围内开放预订。
